coastal.title: Liberal Braeden Caley wins byelection in North Vancouver-Capilano
coastal.description: The contest was one of three federal byelections  on Monday, with others in Ontario and Quebec also won by the Liberals.

coastal.title: New Wolverine video game features Squamish Nation's language, B.C. locations
coastal.description: A sign featuring the Squamish Nation's language and several B.C. locations are on display in a new Wolverine video game that’s expected to draw millions of players globally.

prince-george.title: Cole Hosack vanished from Dawson Creek, B.C., in 2023. Does this man know what happened to him?
prince-george.description: New evidence, including a potential confession, has been uncovered in an investigation by the CBC's the fifth estate into the suspicious disappearance of a man in northern British Columbia.

southeast.title: Change needed after 'multiple failures' led to grizzly deaths, Wildsafe B.C. co-ordinator says
southeast.description: The outgoing community co-ordinator of Wildsafe B.C. Nelson is calling for change, after she says "multiple failures ... on many levels" led to the killing of a grizzly sow and two of her three yearlings this month.
